findings.passage: In a time when public confidence in our elections is fading, the public’s confidence in national, state, local, and municipal elections should be a priority. Americans across the board agree that an ID requirement maintains the integrity and confidence in our elections. When local control is removed from a community and left to the State, trust is eroded.
findings.note: Part of his letter to the Governor asking for a veto of SB 1174, the bill that bars cities and counties from requiring voter ID in local elections. The letter is on his Senate site and signed by him.
subjects: voter ID at the polls
local voter-ID bans (SB 1174 of 2024)
election integrity
local control of elections

findings.passage: SB-1174 is unbridled government overreach and diminishes public trust, while imposing the will of the State on local community and municipality election processes in a time when election integrity is deteriorating.
findings.note: Closing argument of the same veto-request letter on SB 1174.
